Residents:
Yuki (50s, WFH): Weekdays 9:00-17:30 at desk_b1. Often out for lunch. Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s, Office): Weekdays out ~8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.

Object Locations & Movements:
Static Items:
- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Nora’s skincare/toiletry bag on shelf; razor on sink; towels on rack.
- Bedroom 1 (Yuki): Desk has laptop, charger, pen. Nightstand has book, tablet. Wardrobe empty (gym bag moved).
- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Dog leash, hat on hook. Keys, wallet on table. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dishes in cupboard/sink. Dog bowl on floor. Dog food in pantry.
- Living: Standard furniture items (couch, table, shelf).

Dynamic Items (Wednesday Update):
At 00:00, both residents were home. Yuki returned from evening activity, bringing back gym bag, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, umbrella, wallet, and water bottle to the entryway. Nora’s work items (backpack, laptop, lunchbox, notebook, pen, water bottle) and personal accessories (scarf, sunglasses, wallet, shoes) were also in the entryway.
At 08:00, Nora left for work, taking her backpack, laptop, lunchbox, notebook, pen, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet, and water bottle. Yuki remained home.
At 12:00, Yuki was at desk_b1 with mug, tablet, and water bottle.
At 16:00, Yuki moved mug, plate, and water bottle to sink_k1.
At 20:00, Nora returned home. Her items (backpack, jacket, keys, laptop, lunchbox, notebook, pen, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet, water bottle) were found in various spots: entryway (backpack, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet), bedroom 2 (laptop, notebook, pen, phone), and kitchen (lunchbox, water bottle). Yuki’s items were also redistributed: gym bag to desk_b1, hat to dresser_b1, shoes to shoe_rack_e1, wallet to entry_table_e1, water bottle to dish_rack_k1.
At 21:14, kitchen items (cutting board, glasses, knife, pan, plates, pot, spatula, water bottle) were moved to sink/dish rack, suggesting cleanup.

Routine Inferences:
- Yuki: Leaves house in evening for gym/running. Returns by 00:00. Takes gym bag, jacket, shoes, umbrella, keys, wallet, water bottle.
- Nora: Leaves for work ~08:00, returns ~17:30-20:00. Takes work items and personal accessories.
- Dog: Stays home. Leash and food bag move between entry/kitchen/pantry.

Current Status (Wed 23:59):
- Yuki: Home.
- Nora: Home.
- Dog: Home.
- Entryway: Cluttered with both residents' items.
- Kitchen: Cleanup in progress.
